title: Freeze the table2_v1 randomization declaration
summary: Commit 06aca4e6 froze the table2_v1 declaration at SHA-256 730cad98 and its 27-cell grid at 7d631f12, with no change to the declaration bytes. A test pins both hashes. The training guide and the locomotion guide now state that the declaration is frozen. The decision followed a CPU surrogate comparison of none and table2_v1 on five seeds each to 4000 updates: at update 4000 the arms passed 15 of 15 and 14 of 15 focus probes and a mean of 35.8 and 36.6 of 81 grid cells (permutation p 0.97); at update 2000, mid-schedule, table2_v1 was behind (33.0 against 23.4, p 0.008). These are surrogate results, not native evidence. The commit added no update record; this record covers it.
next: Apply the frozen motor and friction draws in the native environment.
reason: Pins an unchanged declaration and grid hash: no native run, admission, gate threshold or accepted capability changes.
